```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
file_path <-"retail_limpio.csv"

retail_limpio <- read.csv(file_path)

```


```{r}
retail_limpio.csv <- read.csv("retail_limpio.csv")
df_limpio <- retail_limpio.csv %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Date = ymd(Date))

print(paste("Total de filas limpias:", nrow(df_limpio)))
```
